coverage.summary: Applies to owners of residential rental property in Berkeley and their agents. Covers all residential rental agreements, including existing ones, regardless of contrary lease language. The source states no unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits.

evidence.quoted_span: When an owner or the owner’s agent gets a request to rent residential property in Berkeley from an applicant
Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of any contractual language in any rental agreement or lease to the contrary.
An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant
Chapter 13.78 applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of any contractual language in any rental agreement or lease to the contrary.

result.notes: I removed the summary's claim that ch. 13.78 'adds to the state screening-fee cap ... and does not replace them' because no verbatim passage states that relationship. D005 only says limits exist 'under state and local law'. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the chapter covers all residential rental agreements in Berkeley. D005 gives no exemptions, unit thresholds or construction cutoffs. The ordinance text itself is not in the corpus, so any exemptions in BMC ch. 13.78 cannot be verified.
